hints.en: Say you went to see a movie with your wife.
t: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 lou5 po4 heoi3 zo2 tai2 hei3.

hints.en: Say you thought it was great.
Say you've had BBQ pork buns before, and they're delicious.
t: ngo5 sik6 gwo3 caa1 siu1 baau1, hou2 hou2 sik6!

hints.en: Suggest going for dim sum together.
t: 不如我哋一齊去飲茶啦！
bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4 laa1!

hints.en: Say not yet, you haven't been to Hong Kong.
t: mei6 aa3, ngo5 mei6 heoi3 gwo3 hoeng1 gong2.

hints.en: Say you plan to go with your wife.
t: ngo5 daa2 syun3 tung4 ngo5 lou5 po4 heoi3.

hints.en: Say you want to go for dim sum and eat BBQ pork buns.
t: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 jam2 caa4, sik6 caa1 siu1 baau1!

hints.en: Say that because you want to go to Hong Kong, you're learning Cantonese.
t: 因為我想去香港，所以我學緊廣東話。
jan1 wai6 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2, so2 ji5 ngo5 hok6 gan2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
